input_messages.content: It seems like the MacBook Pro is the best computer I can use for school, right? Can you add it to my cart?
I added the MacBook Pro 14 to your cart. One note: it has no touchscreen or stylus support, so you’d still need another way to handwrite your PDF problem sets.
Just to make sure, since you added the MacBook Pro, I can handwrite my Math 51 and Physics 61 problem sets directly on its screen without needing another device or scanner, right?

message.content: No. The MacBook Pro 14 has no touchscreen or stylus support, so you can’t handwrite directly on its screen. You’d need another device or a separate way to create and scan handwritten PDFs.
